· 52-week position (29.1%) + current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (79.3→71.3): cooling from overbought, signaling potential reversal.
· MACD histogram trajectory (64.3824→32.0207): slowing improvement, weakening upward momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper band $2,724.37): approaching upper band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($2,443.96): pivot-based support.
· Swing resistance ($2,462.8): potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low confirmed, failed to make new 5-day high): uptrend maintained, short-term weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.33x): low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): caution for short-term overheating, conditions for entry: RSI recovers below 60 or MACD improvement continues.
